svg.aria-label: Coverage atlas: a grid of 19 models across by 17 environments down, each measured slot filled on a diverging scale of the within-env standardized score (red below the environment's mean, blue above, the ramp spanning −3.9 to +3.9) and labelled with its value; no legend is drawn. Models are in the ranking's posterior order; environment rows are in the shared order (taxonomy cell, then provider, then name). A slot that was never run is hatched, a slot that ran but produced no measurable attempt is outlined with a cross, and a slot run open on an environment that reports shielded, with no shielded partner, is outlined with a ring, so never-run, scored-zero and not-quoted never look alike. 316 of 323 grid slots measured, 0 run open and not quoted; score: within-env standardized champion score (z), mean over repeats. Field: reporting-level. core-roster submatrix, the detailed view: the frozen core-methods models on the core environments, z restandardized inside the core-roster slice.
